prompt:
Task: Estimate the recorded transcoding runtime on the source Intel i7-3720QM execution setup from input-video characteristics and the requested output encoding settings.
Target: transcoding_time
Target unit: s
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing.
Field definitions and context: duration: original video duration in seconds; codec/o_codec: input/requested output codec; width,height,o_width,o_height: input/output pixel dimensions; bitrate,o_bitrate: source-recorded input/output bitrate values, unscaled; framerate,o_framerate: frames per second; i,p,b: source counts of I/P/B frames; frames: total frames; i_size,p_size,b_size,size: source-recorded component and total byte sizes. The source experiment transcodes short segments; full original duration is metadata, not a claim of processing every original frame. Output memory consumption is excluded.
Input JSON: {"duration":130.35667,"codec":"mpeg4","width":176,"height":144,"bitrate":54590,"framerate":12,"i":27,"p":1537,"b":0,"frames":1564,"i_size":64483,"p_size":825054,"b_size":0,"size":889537,"o_codec":"mpeg4","o_bitrate":56000,"o_framerate":12,"o_width":176,"o_height":144}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
